meta.title: Culinary Excellence - Lumina Alpine Retreat
meta.description: Savor exceptional Michelin-starred cuisine featuring locally-sourced Alpine ingredients, artisanal preparations, and an award-winning wine cellar.

data.title: Culinary Excellence
data.description: Our Michelin-starred kitchen celebrates the rich culinary heritage of the Alps through innovative techniques and the finest local ingredients.

data.label: Dining Experiences
data.title: Alpine Gastronomy Redefined
data.description: Executive Chef Marco Steinbacher brings two Michelin stars to our mountain retreat, crafting menus that honor local traditions while pushing culinary boundaries.

items.title: Alta Restaurant
items.description: Our flagship fine-dining restaurant offers a seven-course tasting menu that changes with the seasons. Each dish tells a story of the Dolomites through flavors, textures, and presentations inspired by the mountain landscape.

image.alt: Elegant fine dining restaurant with mountain view windows and artisanal place settings

items.title: Summit Lounge
items.description: Casual dining with panoramic views featuring locally-inspired small plates, artisanal cheeses, and craft cocktails made with Alpine botanicals. Perfect for après-ski or sunset dining.

image.alt: Rooftop lounge with comfortable seating, mountain views, and artisanal cocktail service

items.title: Private Wine Cellar
items.description: Over 800 carefully selected wines from Alpine regions and renowned international vineyards. Enjoy private tastings with our sommelier in our temperature-controlled cellar carved into the mountain.

image.alt: Elegant wine cellar with stone walls, professional lighting, and extensive wine collection

data.label: Wine Collection
data.title: Curated Alpine Wines
data.description: Discover exceptional wines from the unique terroir of Alpine regions, personally selected by our head sommelier from small family producers.

image.alt: Sommelier carefully selecting wine bottles in professional cellar environment

wines.name: Gewürztraminer Gran Cuvée
wines.description: Aromatic and complex white wine with notes of rose petals, lychee, and spice. Perfect pairing with our Alpine cheese selection.

wines.name: Lagrein Riserva
wines.description: Full-bodied indigenous red with dark fruit flavors and hints of chocolate. Ideal companion to our house-cured speck and game dishes.

wines.name: Franciacorta Brut
wines.description: Elegant Italian sparkling wine with fine perlage and crisp minerality. Our sommelier's choice for celebrations and aperitifs.

wines.name: Moscato Rosa Passito
wines.description: Rare dessert wine with intense floral aromatics and honeyed sweetness. The perfect conclusion to our tasting menu.
